title: BaseHarbor Candidate Contract 1
description: Exact source/image submission contract. A candidate is a fixed source revision, image digest, or native compose/quadlet unit. A submission must carry exactly one immutable identity source (source revision OR image digest, never a mutable tag alone) and never a bare secret reference. Provenance is never inferred from annotations. The exactly-one-source invariant, the explicit operator/automation consent that pins the validated submission, and the pinned-source-or-image-digest rule are asserted in Go (internal/delivery candidate contract); this schema enforces the structural identity: contract_version const, required app/target/consent bindings, exactly one of source|image with a fixed source revision or a sha256-pinned image, and no unexpected keys. Consent is mandatory and carries the identity through by/at/digest; acknowledged is no longer a structural field (identity lives in the consent).

by.description: operator/automation principal that explicitly acknowledged the candidate submission

at.description: RFC 3339 time the operator/automation acknowledged the candidate submission

digest.description: canonical content-hash of the validated submission; the persisted consent binds the exact submission that was validated
